Third passage: about two main problems, method: place cold eggs in single layer in pan with enough cold water to cover them by about 1 inch. Then place pan on stove over high heat. Supported: first passage says place over high heat; third passage also says over high heat. So supported.

Supported: first passage says when water just starts to simmer, turn off heat, cover, let stand for 17 minutes. So supported.

First passage includes step 3: "Don't peek." That's same as not uncover. So supported.

5. "After 17 minutes, pour out the hot water and pour cold water over the eggs."

Supported: first passage step 4 says pour out hot water and pour cold water over eggs. So supported.

6. "To test if the egg is hard boiled, spin it on a table; if it spins fast and easily, it is hard boiled."

Supported: second passage says whirl on a table, if spins fast and easy, it is hard boiled. So supported.

7. "If it wobbles, it needs more time."

Supported: second passage says if it wobbles, it needs more time. So supported.
